strategies.name: Machine learning – single-stock KNN
strategies.desc: Predict the next-week return from price/volume features by averaging what happened after the k most similar past days (k-nearest neighbours), then trade the forecast.

tables.title: Live 5-day forecasts for constituents (10 long / 8 short)

notes: Features (min-max normalised over the training window): price / SMA(5, 20, 60) − 1, 5- and 20-day return, 20-day volatility, volume ratio (Eqs. 333-337). Target = next 5-day return. Walk-forward: each day the k = ⌊√504⌋ = 22 nearest neighbours in the previous 504 days (whose targets are already known) are averaged (Eq. 339). Long if forecast > z₁ (0.3σ of past returns), short if < −z₁, liquidated when the forecast crosses zero (Eq. 341).
Index volume is not published by Yahoo, so the volume feature is only used for stocks with volume data.

strategies.name: Artificial neural network (ANN)
strategies.desc: Train a small neural network on technical indicators to forecast which return quantile comes next, and buy/sell on the predicted class.
strategies.adapted_note: Book strategy trades Bitcoin; applied to NIFTY 50 / SENSEX daily data.

notes: Adapted from the book's Bitcoin ANN: inputs are the normalised daily return, EMA and EMSD (τ = 5, 10, 20, 40, λ = (τ−1)/(τ+1)) and RSI (τ = 5, 14, 30) (Eqs. 521-529). Output = probability that the next day's normalised return falls in the low / middle / high tercile (K = 3).

Network 12 → 16 → 8 → 3 (ReLU hidden layers, softmax output, cross-entropy loss, Adam). Walk-forward: retrained every 63 days on the previous 3 years only; all reported results are out-of-sample. Signal: buy if the top tercile is most likely, sell if the bottom tercile is, otherwise flat (Eq. 537).
The book applies this to cryptocurrencies at 15-minute resolution; here it is daily on the index. Expect weak edge – equity indexes are far more efficient than crypto.
